single.rationale: Parker-Hannifin shows strong operational execution with expanding margins (21.9% operating margin) and excellent cash generation (16.8% FCF margin), but revenue has stalled (flat YoY in FY2025) amid macroeconomic headwinds in industrial markets. The aerospace segment (31% of sales) provides growth offset, while valuation appears stretched at 32.6x P/E and 5.0x EV/revenue for a company with near-zero revenue growth.
